page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Page number and running head at the top. Two italic question headings and two roman title headings, with the text in paragraphs between them. A catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Quot species liberorum vulgò nu-
merantur?
Sex: prima species naturalium & legitimorum si-
mul, secunda naturaliù tantùm, tertia legitimorum
tantùm, quarta spuriorum seu vulgò quæsitorum,
quinta incestuosorum & ex damnato coitu suscepto-
rum, sexta spiritualium.
Qui sunt liberi naturales & legiti-
mi simul?
Qui ex justis nuptiis, seu legitimo matrimonio
nati sunt l. filium definimus. ff.de his qui sunt sui vel
alien.jur.Vulgò Ehelicheꝫ gebohne Kinder [?]. Inter hosce
liberos refert Schneidewinus per subsequens ma-
trimonium legitimatos.
De horum successione sequentes ob-
servandæ sunt Regulæ.
Prima Regula?
Liberi naturales & legitimi tàm masculi, quàm
fœminæ, sive in patria potestate existentes, sive eman-
cipati, hodie præferuntur omnibus aliis: Et suis a-
scendentibus æqualiter succedunt in capita. Authen.
in successio̅n. C. de suis & legitimis liberis.
Obiter autem observandum, quòd successio in ca-
pita dicitur fieri, quando hæreditas secundùm nu-
merum personarum, quibus defertur, dividitur in
viriles seu æquales portiones, ut ibi tot sint partes,
quot capita vel personæ, & unus tantùm habeat, quan-
tum alter.
In stirpes verò fit divisio hæreditatis in portiones
inæquales, quando plures succedunt in locum alte-
rius, qui eam tantùm partem accipiunt, quam is, in
cujus locum succedunt accepisset, & non numeran-
tur succedentium personæ sive capita: sed unius tan-tùm

page.notes: The first letter of "Quot" and "Qui" and "Prima Regula" is a decorated initial; read as Q and R. The black letter words "Ehelicheꝫ gebohne Kinder" are read with doubt, especially "Kinder" (marked [?]). The line "Authen. in successio̅n." has a macron over the n; read as successionem and printed as is. Long s is set as plain s throughout. The catchword "tantùm" stands at the lower right, offset from the text.
